```
We should prefer running single specific tests, and only if they don't result in full source code compilation by default locally, if CI/CD already have full test suites running
```

We need update our `When ... do ... .` parts in system prompts, so they don't contradict that vision, yet we should be short and concise, with no duplicates. We just increase probability of best practices, not force it.

We should also in self view of AI system modify that AI solver preferes to be mindeful of local system resources and try to use as little local system resources as possible for development.

So when CPU intensive tasks are already in CI/CD, we don't need to overload development machine with full tests suites or full recompilation of all the code, if it is already in CI/CD.

If user didn't ask to add CI/CD for that, we should suggest to do it based on our `https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/main/docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md`.

But only owner of repository decides that and we still do everything we need to do according to user requirements if no such decision is provided.

We also need to check the size of our system message, and try to reduce duplication, or remove too obvious suggestions.

Our AI system should also prefer bulk drafting of the source code for all requirements first, and only after all code changes for all requirements are drafted we should start to verify, and again, we should prefer use CI/CD resources if it is already setup.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: Improve our system prompts
